items.name: b-research-weapon-edges-1-v2
items.subject: WEAPON EDGES I (melee weapons, tier one of three, the plainest): a beetle hammer head forged of PLAIN DARK GREY IRON ONLY, rough hammered surface, with a freshly ground bright steel striking edge. NO blue paint, NO brass, NO glass: only grey iron and the bright edge, so it reads clearly plainer than the higher tiers.

items.name: b-research-plating-1-v2
items.subject: PLATING I (armour, tier one of three, the plainest): one thick curved shoulder plate of PLAIN DARK GREY RIVETED IRON ONLY, a row of plain iron rivets along its edge. NO blue paint, NO brass, NO glass: only grey iron, so it reads clearly plainer than the higher tiers.

items.name: b-research-riveted-hulls-1-v2
items.subject: RIVETED HULLS I (machines gain health, tier one of two, the plainer): a single curved hull plate of PLAIN DARK GREY IRON with one row of big round iron rivets and a riveted seam. NO blue paint, NO brass: only grey iron.
